SPACE_BEFORE is measured against the previous element in the READING-ORDER FLOW, with background panels (banner, foot band, watermark) excluded from that flow - so the QR code's space_before is measured from the page top edge, and contents_panel and block 2 both measure from the bottom of the chapter title since they start side by side. TEXT_BLOCK is the rectangle the body type actually occupies: left column left edge to right column right edge, top of the first printed line (y=993) to the baseline of the last (y=1913); the chapter title above it sits inside the banner and is excluded. FILL 0.84 = the printed content depth (993-1920 px, 927 px) over the depth available between the first printed line and the top of the foot band (993-2093 px, 1100 px) - the page stops about four body lines short of the band, mid-sentence, and the text continues on the next page. SIZE_PT is derived, not read directly: the page is 1700 px over an 8.5 in trim, i.e. a 200 dpi render, so 1 pt = 2.778 px, and an em is estimated from cap height assuming cap height = 0.70 em (this puts body text at ~11 pt, which matches NCERT's setting). Treat every size_pt as approximate to about +/-0.5 pt; size_rel is the measured figure. Note also that the brief's 'Rules for this step' asks for size_pt on headings and captions while its 'Never' list forbids absolute point sizes - size_pt is supplied here per the runner's explicit instruction, and size_rel is always present as the measured ratio. All five A2 blocks were matched by position with confidence; no n was guessed. 11 elements.
